dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical 2D narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with a subtle asymmetrical indentation on the posterior right flank where the torso meets the water interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Concentrated irregular dark-grey patches on the anterior melon; sparse, low-density faint marks on the posterior right dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp, high-contrast gradient on the anterior cranial patches; diffuse transitions on posterior lateral markings.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: High-contrast dark blowhole orifice; distinct irregular grey patches on the rostrum; subtle linear rake marks on the posterior right quadrant.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Transverse integumentary folds visible in the cervical region immediately posterior to the blowhole.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear markings resembling healed rake scars on the posterior right dorsal plane; residual pigmentation or scarring on the melon.
